tei:div.tei:p: 291) klong chen rab 'byams ye shes sgyu ma'i gar// bde chen rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// mtshungs med bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma rje// 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pa'i zhabs la 'dud// 'bral med spyi bo bde chen 'khor lor bzhugs// bdag rgyud chos dang 'dres par byin gyis rlobs// e ma gson dang snying gi bu mchog lags// lus rten bzang po yid bzhin nor las lhag /dal ba'i rten bzang chud zos ma btang bar// mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin dben ri bsten// sgo gsum zhi zhing bag yod tshul ldan mdzod// dman pa'i sa bzung 'gran sems phrag dog spongs// chos brgyad tshe 'di'i bya ba ma dran par// sdod tshugs rang sems snang ba nang du skyongs// yul grong dgon gseb khyi bzhin ma nyul bar// mtshams bcad sgo gsum bya ba chos dang bstun// bla ma'i gdams ngag 'od gsal rdzogs chen bsgom// 'dre 'dul grong chog 'ar 'ur dgos pa med// thos bsam sgom pa'i lam la slob pa'i dus// rang mthong nga rgyal che 'dod ma bsam par// rim bzhin nyams longs 292)rang rgyud chos dang bstun// nyams chung mdzod la kun dang mthun par gyis// dus gsum rgyal kun las lhag bla ma yis// brtse bas rjes bzung smin grol pha phog stsal// don med chud zos ma byed rim gnyis bsgom// rang don mthar phyin gzhan don ngal med mdzod// lhag bsam dag pa'i sa gzhi khod snyoms brdal// sdom gsum skyon med rnam dag sa bon thobs// bslab gsum yon tan 'bras bu ris med longs// rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen mthar son mdzod// mdor na dus kun ri khrod dben ri zungs// rnyed bkur zhabs tog phyir du mi 'brang bar// dka' spyad gyis la dman pa'i zas gos bsten// dkor nag log 'tsho'i zas la dug bzhin spongs// sha chang bud med thar pa'i gshed ma yin// rang nyid gcig pu dben rir btsan sa zungs// gnyis 'dzin 'khor ba'i sdig grogs rgyang nas spongs// grwa 'khor gnyer pa la sogs dgos pa med// phar la gces spras byas kyang tshur la sdang*// rang dbang gzhan la shor ba'i snga ltas yin// rang sdug rang gi rin gyis nyos pa 'dra// grogs med gcig pu bag yangs blo bde mdzod// yang gcig gson dang snying gi bu

293)mchog khyod// gdams ngag rtsa ba rdzogs chen dmar khrid yin// nyams len snying po gcig dril 'di la brtson// chos brgyad bya bas dgos med snying gi bu// grogs kyi mchog gyur rang byung rig pa yin// gnyis 'dzin mthun 'khon grogs kyis dgos med bu// gos kyi mchog gyur gtum mo rang byung yin// sgyu ma'i rdzas kyis dgos med snying gi bu// lam gyi mchog gyur thabs shes lto sbyor yin// yo ga gsum ldan lam mchog khyad du 'phags// tshul 'chos gtsang spyod kun spangs mtshan ldan bsten// rags pa mnyam sbyor lhar snang 'du 'bral med// skad cig dran rdzogs dag pa 'od kyi lus// bskyed pa ma hā yo gar lhun gyis grub// dga' bzhis nyer drangs stong bzhi'-i 'od gsal mngon// gdos bcas zag zad zag med 'od skur smin// bde chen a nu yo gar lhun gyis grub// dbyings ye gnyis med dbu mar rlung sems tshud// cig char rig pa lhun rdzogs ye shes mthong*// nyon gsum rtog pa dbyings bcom 'dzin pa bral// don dam a ti yo gar lhun gyis grub// bu khyod gsang zhing*/gsang bar nyams su longs/ gsang 294)ba'i dngos grub thams cad 'di las thob// 'bras bu tshe gcig don gyi sangs rgyas brnyes// 'dod lugs grub mtha' mang pos dgos pa med// lam mchog 'di la brtson cig snying gi bu// rang rig ye gzhi mi 'gyur byang chub sems// gdod nas rnam dag sku gsum lhun grub kyi// ma btsal rang la gnas pa'i ye shes che// blo bral rnam thar gsum ldan e ma ho// rang bzhin ma 'gags sku lnga ye shes lnga// zhing lnga mkha' 'gro lnga sogs lhun grub kyi// yon tan rang chas rdzogs pa e ma ho// ye grol ka dag phyis nas grol mi dgos// gang shar rang grol 'dzin med chen por grol// nyon mongs gnas dag ye shes ngang du grol// thams cad dag mnyam lhun grub chen por grol// spang blang gnyis med gang snang ye shes grol// gzung 'dzin las 'das khyab brdal ngang du grol// ma rig ming med 'od gsal ngang du grol// dgag sgrub zhen bral ka dag lhun 'byams grol// re dogs gnyis med ro snyoms ngang du grol/

khams gsum sems can kun bzang klong du grol// thams cad ye grol ma grol gcig kyang med// da ni sems bde blo bder nyol la sdod// bcas bcos mi dgos gang dgar bskyur la thongs// gtad med rgya yan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor mdzod/ 295)/kun rdzob byis pa'i chos kyis dgos pa med// mdor na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// yengs med 'dzin med spros bral ngang du zhog /phyogs lhung bral ba'i 'od gsal ngang gis 'char// rtsa bral klong yangs rig pa de bzhin nyid/ khyad chos drug ldan gzhon nu bum pa'i skur// spros mtha' brgyad bral blo 'das rdzogs pa che// 'bras bu phyi dus mi re rang thag chod// rang rig kun tu bzang po e ma ho// sprul pa'i sku mchog 'jigs med mtshan can gyis// de skad dgos zhes nan cher bkas bskul ngor// mdo med 'chol mo su kha badzra gyis// zhal gdams mi shes gang dran ne tso'i gtam// 'chal 'chol yi ge'i ris su bris pa'o// dge'o// pha dus gsum kun mkhyen padma 'byung*// don dbyer med rig 'dzin kun skyong gling*// mtshungs med rje la gsol ba 'debs// bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzod// e ma gson dang snying gi bu// lus rten bzang po yid bzhin nor las lhag /chud zos ma byed mtshan ldan bla ma brten// bla ma mjal tshe skyon du ma brtag bu// brtags na skyon 296)gyi rang bzhin rnam rtog rgyu// dag snang gyis la dbang bzhis thugs yid bsres// thos bsam sgom pa'i lam la slob pa'i dus// rang mthong nga rgyal che 'dod ma bsam par// sgo gsum zhi zhing dul ba'i bag yod dgos// rim bzhin nyams su longs la gnad dang bstun// mched grogs rdo rje'i spun dang 'grogs pa'i tshe// 'gran sems phrag dog chos brgyad bya ba spongs/ khong khro dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu yin bu// nyams chung gyis la kun dang mthun par gyis// ri khrod dben par sgrub pa byed pa'i dus// yul grong dgon gseb khyi bzhin ma 'grims par// 'dug tshugs sems nyid snang ba nang du khug

/bsam gtan bsgom la snying rus bskyed dus su// chos brgyad tshe 'di'i bya ba ma dran bu// dran na rnyen bkur zhabs tog phyir du rgyugs// dka' spyad gyis la dman pa'i zas gos brten// 'od gsal gsang lam rdzogs chen bsgom dus su// 'dre 'dul grong chog ca co 'ur ma byed// rang rgyud mi grol bsgom la bar chad mang*// mtshams bcad sgo gsum gnad dang bstun gal che// nyams rtogs yon tan rgyud la skyes ba'i tshe// snod min dam nyams rnams la ma bshad 297)bu// bshad na lam rtags yon tan sgrib nyen yod// ma yengs ma bsgom yengs med ngang la zhog /mdor na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// nyams chung gyis la ri khrod dben ri zungs// nyams len rtsa ba bla ma'i gdams ngag bsgom// chos brgyad bya bas dgos med 'khrul pa'i rgyu// grogs kyi mchog gyur rang byung ye shes yin// gnyis 'dzin 'khor ba'i sdig grogs rgyang nas spongs// gos su rtsol bral gtum mo'i sgron me sbor// mig 'phrul sgyu ma'i rdzas kyis dgos pa med// zag med bcud mchog srog rtsol rlung la slob// zag bcas 'dod pa'i zas kyi chags pa spongs// rang snang dag pa gnas mchog yid 'ong ldan// 'thab 'khon 'jig rten grong dgon zhe sdang rgyu// dgos med gcig pur dben ri'i btsan sa zungs// longs spyod rgyu nor 'phags pa'i nor bdun yod// 'di phyi'i blo phugs gtad sa bzhi la gyis// rgyun du lus rten tha mal ma 'dug bu// lus snang lhar gsal ngag kyang sngags kyi sgra// dran rtog chos sku'i klong du g.yo med zhog /de skad nyams len mdzod cig snying gi bu// gzhi skye med stong pa'i 298)nam mkha' la// tshig gi brjod byas gzhal ma nus// dpe mtshon na me long gsal ba bzhin// phyi nang gsal sgrib med pa yi// chos sku skye med nyi ma'i snying*// 'od la gsal sgrib med do bu// rnam rtog chu nang ral gri bzhin// don la khe nyen med do bu// rig pa ka dag zang thal la// thogs rdugs med do snying gi bu// lta ba gtad med rgya yan la// mi lta lta ba lta ba'i mchog

/sgom pa rtsol bral gnyug ma la// mi sgom sgom pa sgom pa'i mchog /spyod pa rang grol blang dor bral// mi spyod spyod pa spyod pa'i mchog /gzhi ka dag zang thal chos kyi sku// lam ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// rtsal thugs rje sprul skus 'gro don mdzad// de'i 'bras bu rang rig btsan sa zin// gson dang skal ldan bu khyod// pha gcig bla ma'i zhal nas// gsungs bzhin gdams pa zab mo// myur lam snying po'i khyad chos// rdzogs chen gsang ba'i lam mchog khregs thod dbyer med zung 'jug /rim bzhin nyams su blangs na// rang rig skye med chos sku'i// rang zhal ngang gis mjal yong*// ka dag zang thal chos 299)sku// bsam brjod bral ba blo 'das// stong gsal 'gags med rang byung*// mtha' dbus med pa'i khyab brdal// gtad med rgya yan nam mkha'// gzhi med rtsa bral ka dag /gsal stong 'dzin med rang grol// gnyug ma shugs 'byung rol pa// smra med klong yangs chen po// rang byung rig pa chos sku// re dogs bral ba'i so ma*// yengs 'khrul med pa'i 'od gsal// 'dzin med spros bral zang thal// 'gyur med ye grol chen po// sku gsum rang chas rdzogs pa'i// rnal 'byor dam pa mdzod cig /'chi ba dang po'i 'od gsal// ma pang bu ru 'jug dus// rig pa'i btsan sa zungs la// dbyings gsum dbyer med ngang du// 'u cag mched lcam mjal yong*// de min zhal gdams mi shes// 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sprang mor// gdams ngag med pa thag chod/ khyod kyis nan tan bskul phyir// zhal ngo ma ldog tsam du// ca co ne tso'i gtam bzhin// su kha'i ming gis bris pa// bha dra'i thugs la zungs dang*// cung zhig go rgyu yod thang*// phyi ma dag pa'i zhing nas// ston 'khor tshul du mjal yong*/ ces pa ne tso'i gtam 'di yang 300)chos med sprang mo su kha'i ming gis bris pa dge legs 'phel//

rang byung rig pa ka dag rtsa ba bral// bcos bsgyur 'dzin pas ma bcings rang babs ngang*// gsal stong gnyis med ye shes ngang du skyong*// kun bzang rang zhal so ma'i rang mdangs ngoms// rdzogs chen dgongs pa smra bsam brjod pa bral// gnyis 'dzin blo yis ma bcos ngang la zhog /de skad dad ldan btsun pa rnam dag la// mdo med chos med bde ba'i rdo rje yis// gsal 'debs kha ta'i tshul du bris pa 'di// btang snyoms ma byed nyams len sna gcig rem// rang rig las gzhan sangs rgyas yod mi srid// kun tu bzang po'i sa mchog e ma ho// 'jig rten chos brgyad bya bas dgos pa med// zin dus mi 'byung rang gzhan phung ba'i rgyu// dug bzhin spongs la dben rir btsan sa zungs// pha gcig bla ma'i gdams pa nyams len rem// dgos med bya ba ma dran sems la zungs// ngal ba don med dal 'byor chud zos 'gro// de don sems la zungs dang go rgyu yod// mdo med sprang mos kha chems tshul du bris// phyi mar rang re mjal ba'i smon lam yod/ dge'o// 301)kyai ma/ brtse chen thugs kyis bskyangs ba'i mched grogs lags// bde ba'i rdo rje'i gnas tshul rnams// sbas gsang med par zhu lags na/ khyed rnams bdag gi skye grogs mdzod// ser dgon dben ri'i g.yas zur na// mgon med dbus mo gcig pur phud// skyo chad de ba la dwangs dus med// mgon dus gsum sangs rgyas dbyings su gshegs// yid dung nge ba la brjed dus med/ khyung dkar pos nam zla'i tshad bzung byed// skad snyan pos kring kring zer zhing 'gro// des kyang rje btsun bla ma dran// shing rtsa ba med pa'i rtse mo nas// bya byi'u mang pos ca co'i sgra// rang skad kyi snyan dbyangs lhang lhang byed// des kyang rje= sos rtsi dmar gyis la lung kun tu gang*// sa ser po'i kha dog snum la mdzes// des kyang= dpyid nyi ma dus ngan tshe las ring*// 'bris be'u khyur khrid rtse 'jo byed// des kyang=

mi phal gyis sems spro'i glu len byed// rta rgod po'i bang la mgyogs ngom byas// nga sdug mo'i sems rtsa rlung gis bskyod// des kyang= mgon dus gsum sangs rgyas yid bzhin nor// 'gran bral gyi gsang gsum yon tan dang*// man ngag gi gdams khrid gnang ba dang*// byams 302)brtse ba'i thugs kyis bskyangs ba sogs// de bsam zhing yang yang bla ma dran// spyir sgyu ma rmi lam yin mod kyang*// nga sgyu ma'i nang gi sgyu rgod byung*// rje dngos su bzhugs tshe 'khor tshogs mang*// lus srog la mi ltos ci dga' phul// rje dbyings su gshegs tshe rang sa 'tsho// rgyu che chung ci 'bul rang bdag byed// nga mgon med bu mo'i sems bsad tshe// des kyang rje btsun bla ma dran// rjes gces par bskyangs ba'i rigs bzang ma// 'khor kun gyi nang nas skal bar ldan// 'bangs bu slob rnams kyis gces pas bskyangs/ da nag can mi bzhin sa mthar spyugs// des kyang rje btsun= skyo skyo bu mo'i bsam pa skyo/ sdug sdug mgon med nga rang sdug /dran dran drin chen bla ma dran// bsam bsam 'dir snang 'gags na bsam// yang gcig gson dang brtse ba'i bu// bsgom bsran can gyi sgom pa dang*/ sdug bsran can gyi bu mo nga*// 'dra dang 'dra ste nor pa yod// bsgom pas chos nyid rang zhal mthong*// sdug gis snying rlung stod la 'tshangs// des kyang rje= khong nges med 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// nga yul med spyugs pa'i bdag med gnyis// 'dra dang 303)'dra de nor sa yod// nges med kyis don gnyis mdzad pa 'grub// yul med kyis sdug bsngal mtha' ded byed// des kyang rje= khong bya ba btang ba'i bya bral dang*// nga skyabs mgon med pa'i sprang mo gnyis// 'dra dang 'dra de nor sa yod// bya bral gyi snang ba rgyan du shar// sprang mo yi snang bas 'khrul gzhi byed// des kyang rje=

khong rtogs ldan dben ri 'dzin pa dang*// ngas dben par sdug rgur byed pa de// 'dra dang 'dra de nor sa yod// rtogs ldan tsho dben rir nyams rtogs rgyas// nga dben par 'dug kyang sdug bsngal skyed// des kyang= khong bzod pa thob pa'i byang sems dang*/ kha nyams chung ba'i bu mo gnyis// 'dra dang 'dra de nor sa yod// bzod pas byang chub lam bzang rnyed/ khas zhan nga kun gyis brnyas smod byed// des kyang= gnas tshul 'di la thugs bsam mdzod// sdug bsngal 'di 'dra bzod par dka'// 'gro bsam 'gro dbang bdag la med// mched grogs rnams kyi zhal ma lcogs// 'dug bsam 'dug spro bdag la med// snying med nga yis ci zhig byed// pha bla ma dran pa'i rmongs glu 'di// sems gting nas sdug gis ma bzod nas// dbang med kha nas 'gags med shor/ 304)/snying brtse ba'i mched grogs rnams la phul/ ces ser dgon dben ri'i nye 'dabs nas ku sa li bde skyong dbang mos dam ldan gyi mched grogs rnams kyi drung du dus 'dzin shing glang lo'i zla dang po'iches nyer brgyad la bkra shis lha reg bcas gus phul/ dge'o//
